mapper.select: SELECT rv.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, rv.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, rv.USER_NO AS userNo, rv.FIXER_NO AS fixerNo, rv.SCORE AS score, rv.CONTENT AS content, rv.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, r.TITLE AS requestTitle, u.NAME AS fixerName FROM REVIEW rv LEFT JOIN REPAIR_REQUESTS r ON r.REQUEST_ID = rv.REQUEST_ID LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_NO = rv.FIXER_NO WHERE rv.USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY rv.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVIEW (REQUEST_ID, USER_NO, FIXER_NO, SCORE, CONTENT) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{userNo}, #{fixerNo}, #{score}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT rv.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, rv.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, rv.USER_NO AS userNo, rv.FIXER_NO AS fixerNo, rv.SCORE AS score, rv.CONTENT AS content, rv.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM REVIEW rv WHERE rv.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND rv.USER_NO = #{userNo}
